metadata.description: SYNTHETIC / HAND-AUTHORED PLACEHOLDER -- NOT live-captured, and live capture is explicitly HELD pending org-group Software Distribution (SFD) feature-flag confirmation -- do not attempt a live .zip capture until that flag's status is confirmed on. Do not treat any field value here as a verified real-wire capture. Shape is inferred from (a) the live-captured msi create fixture in this directory tree (field set, PushMode-as-JSON-number defect, Id.Value wrapper -- .zip shares the same WinRT/Software-Distribution device family as .msi) and (b) the canonical ParseZipAndExe/SFD-gate trace documented in vendored-test-apps/windows/SPEC.md section 9, which establishes that .zip create requires the org group's SFD flag ON plus three mandatory request-side fields (SupportedProcessorArchitecture, a full DeploymentOptions block, and FilesOptions.ApplicationUnInstallProcess.CustomScript -- the last one is NOT required for .msi, unlike the first two) but performs NO content inspection of the zip itself (ParseZipAndExe fabricates identity from the blob's own storage id or the caller-supplied BundleId, per SPEC.md). Platform 12 (WinRT) matches msi's own create fixture.
